描述_EN: A set of yongyong from the Sheng Tang period is said to have been excavated from a nobleman's tomb in Luoyang, Henan Province, China. Many of the tombs were destroyed in the past during the construction of the railroad, and it is believed that they were unearthed in a group of tombs.
描述_ZN: 一套盛唐时期的雍容，据说是在中国河南省洛阳的一个贵族墓穴中发掘出来的。 许多墓葬在过去修建铁路时被毁，人们认为它们是在一组墓葬中出土的。
